taxAdvantage.notes: Atlantic Health System operates five hospitals and numerous outpatient facilities across Morris, Union, Sussex, Warren, and Passaic counties in New Jersey, all property-tax-exempt under NJ nonprofit hospital exemption. New Jersey corporate business tax rate is 11.5% for income over $10M. Federal income tax foregone on system net income would be substantial. Tax-exempt bond interest subsidy applies to outstanding NJHCFFA-issued debt. Property tax foregone requires county-by-county assessor data aggregation.
